verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence shows Glama's own platform (registry search, hosting deployment, gateway access control) being operated through natural-language commands. Glama Chat is a multi-model chat interface where users converse with LLMs, for example turning text into diagrams. That is an adjacent feature, not natural-language control of the product itself. The MCP inspector and config blocks let external agents connect to MCP servers, which is also adjacent.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
